about_the_game:
You will play as Mitchelle, a 6-month pregnant woman who is staying in the house with her husband and is involved in a mysterious story. During the game you will visit unsettling places that will cause feelings of fear, anxiety, psychological terror and discomfort. You will have to accomplish specific objectives within the game and rescue the soul of your baby.

GAMEPLAY

As you progress through the game, you will encounter events that will create tension.

FEATURES

  • Unsettling atmosphere

  • Realistic graphics

  • Gameplay: 40 ~ 60 minutes

  • Good plot

  • Atmospheric environment

  • VHS aesthetics

content_descriptors.notes: This game contains intense and disturbing content, including chase scenes and psychological horror. Players are advised to exercise caution. It is not recommended for players who are sensitive to the following themes: fear, anxiety, or graphic scenes. Viewers are strongly advised to exercise caution when viewing the aforementioned themes.

short_description: You play as a pregnant woman kidnapped and trapped in an unknown place. Based on true events, survive a psychological horror journey where every step could cost your life, and your baby. Can you get the best final?
